en: Color postcard-style aerial view over a Scandinavian-looking coastal city at the head of a wide bay or fjord. In the foreground there is a forested hillside with a winding road; below lie dense mid‑20th‑century apartment blocks and a rectangular football stadium with a running track. Farther in the distance spreads a compact city with low and mid-rise buildings, several industrial harbor areas with piers, and a large ship in the water. A prominent red‑brick neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire rises on the right side of the city. Low mountains or forested hills surround the city under a pale blue sky. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.
